zh.title: Air Astana 12 月開航阿斯塔納—曼谷　A321LR 每週兩班
zh.summary: 新航線將於 2026 年 12 月 11 日開航，每週二、五飛航，搭配既有阿拉木圖航線後每週共九班往返泰國。
body: Air Astana 將於 2026 年 12 月 11 日開闢哈薩克首都阿斯塔納至泰國曼谷的直飛航線，使用 Airbus A321LR，每週二與週五各飛一班。
哈薩克交通部公布這項開航計畫；Aviation Week 報導，去程飛行時間約 7 小時 50 分，回程約 8 小時 30 分。
新航線將補充 Air Astana 現有的阿拉木圖—曼谷每日航班，使該公司兩國間班次增至每週九班。

en.title: Air Astana to launch twice-weekly Astana–Bangkok A321LR service on December 11
en.summary: The Tuesday-and-Friday route will lift the carrier's Kazakhstan–Thailand schedule to nine weekly flights when combined with daily Almaty service.
body: Air Astana will open nonstop service between Kazakhstan's capital Astana and Bangkok on December 11, 2026, using Airbus A321LR aircraft. Flights are scheduled twice weekly on Tuesdays and Fridays.
Kazakhstan's transport authorities announced the route. Aviation Week reports an outbound flight time of about seven hours 50 minutes and a return journey of about eight hours 30 minutes.
The new service will complement Air Astana's existing daily Almaty–Bangkok route, bringing the airline's Kazakhstan–Thailand schedule to nine weekly flights.

sources.name: Kazakhstan Ministry of Transport via Interfax

facts.claim: Air Astana will launch nonstop Astana-Bangkok service on 2026-12-11.
The route will operate on Tuesdays and Fridays with Airbus A321LR aircraft.
Together with daily Almaty-Bangkok service, Air Astana will operate nine weekly Kazakhstan-Thailand flights.
